newsitem.title: UK: Entergy mulls bid for Yorkshire Electricity - paper.
newsitem.headline: Entergy mulls bid for Yorkshire Electricity - paper.

text.p: U.S. firm Entergy Corp is considering making a friendly bid of about 1.3 billion stg for Yorkshire Electricity, the Sunday Telegraph said.
The British utility would make an ideal target in view of the power station which Entergy and British Petroleum plan to build on Humberside, near Yorkshire, the paper added.
Yorkshire Electricity could take the power generated under a long-term contract when the station starts operating in 1998, the Sunday Telegraph said.
The newspaper's bid report follows a renewed round of takeovers in the electricity sector.
East Midlands Electricity on Wednesday agreed a 1.3 billion stg takeover from U.S.-based Dominion Resources, while Northern Electric faces a 650 million stg bid from CalEnergy.
Only four of the original 12 regional electricity companies are still independent following privatisation in 1990.
